entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Other articles of plastics and articles of other materials of headings 3901 to 3914
entries.comment: This rate applies only to parts and accessories for the adaptation of cars and other motor vehicles for the disabled: engine handling adjustments; adj. for handling the handbrake; adj. for handling the steering mechanism; specially designed car seats and cushions; adaptation for use of secondary functions, including adj. mirrors, central lockings, windscreen wipers, indicators and lights; car lifts for lifting a person into a car; wheelchair lifting equipment and securing devices.

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Other articles of plastics and articles of other materials of headings 3901 to 3914
entries.comment: For tariff headings of goods intended to service people with vision disabilities the reduced rate applies only on white sticks (6602) Braille typewriters  (8472), on computer programs (jaws, supernova, hall, loudspeaker, fine reader, cellphone programs in Greek and foreign version-mobile speak, speaking phone) (8523), on  Braille printers (8443)  writing frames for people with reduced abilities vision (Braille) (3926)

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection

entries.comment: For tariff headings 3926, 4015, 4818, 6307, reduced rate applies only on protective masks and gloves for medicine (for protection against viruses and prevention of disease transmission for hospital and private use)
